description: This file declares an interface (abstract class) IWarningReportingMedia for warning reporting media within the Thunder::WarningReporting namespace. It defines a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method Output for reporting warnings, and includes licensing information and external dependencies.

classes.name: IWarningReportingMedia
classes.description: An interface for warning reporting media, providing a method to output warning information.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs warning information given a filename, line number, identifier, and warning event details.
